title: Invariants of the extended twisted $h$-Yangian
summary: We investigate the extended twisted $h$-Yangian ${\rm Y}_{N,h}^{\text{tw}}$, a certain algebra which admits both the orthogonal and the symplectic $h$-Yangian as its quotients. We show that ${\rm Y}_{N,h}^{\text{tw}}$ is naturally equipped with the structure of restricted module for a certain algebra ${\rm DY}_{N,h,c}^{tw}$, which resembles the quantum double, as well as with the structure of $φ$-coordinated quasi module for the Etingof-Kazhdan quantum affine vertex algebra associated with the trigonometric $R$-matrix of type $A$.
